rationale: The round 2 exchange added useful quantification from the expert, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee and state actors still insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management, family, and investors still require hard structural capacity reduction. Positions have hardened around an impasse, yet the requested site-by-site numbers and alternative package have not been tested, so another round could still change the factual basis of the debate.
